category: AI astrodynamics and space autonomy infrastructure
one_line_description: AI-native astrodynamics and autonomy infrastructure for mission design, trajectory optimization, simulation, rendezvous planning, and orbital decision-making.
core_problem: Astrodynamics workflows are slow, manual, fragmented, expensive, and hard to validate under uncertainty. Teams rely on bespoke scripts and brittle pipelines, trade studies take too long, and simulation outputs often fail to translate into decision-ready maneuver strategies and autonomy validation evidence.
core_solution: A physics-first AI mission engine that helps teams define mission constraints, generate candidate trajectories and maneuver plans, simulate uncertainty, stress-test autonomy logic, rank options across delta-v/time/robustness/observability/safety/recoverability, and export human-approvable mission decision intelligence.
differentiation: LagrangeOS focuses on decision intelligence, not generic "AI for space math." AI proposes candidates and rationale; physics and constraints bound feasibility; simulation provides robustness evidence; outputs are ranked and packaged for human approval and repeatable validation.

mvp_scope.primary_goal: Deliver a premium, investor-ready, demo-ready website that communicates LagrangeOS as a credible AI-native astrodynamics and autonomy infrastructure startup and provides a durable foundation for iterative product build-out.
included_features: Premium homepage with mission-engine narrative and technical credibility guardrails
Clear positioning: experimental astrodynamics accelerated by AI
Platform features and use cases sections (trajectory generation, optimization, uncertainty simulation, RPO, OD intelligence, autonomy validation, mission memory, cislunar, small-body)
Autobuilder foundation files (.autobuilder/*) to guide safe iteration
future_features: API layer for space software stacks

website.tone: Premium venture-grade frontier space technology: cinematic dark, technical, confident, precise, and honest about validation.

core_flows: Define mission constraints (orbits, timelines, safety, thrust, sensing, comms)
Generate candidate trajectories and maneuver sequences
Simulate uncertainty (dispersions, measurement noise, control errors, fault cases)
Export decision intelligence artifacts for human approval and review
demo_flows: Homepage mission sandbox visual + ranked strategy preview
Narrative workflow: constraints → candidates → simulation → ranking → export
data_model_notes: Scenarios should be represented as structured constraints + initial/final states + environmental model choices.
Ranking outputs should preserve assumptions, constraints, and scoring weights for traceability.
Simulation runs should store dispersion parameters and summary robustness metrics rather than raw trajectories by default.

design_system.visual_style: Dark cinematic, glassy panels, subtle glow, orbital/trajectory visuals, clean grid, luxury technical campaign aesthetic.
design_system.typography: Geist Sans + Geist Mono (next/font/google). Compact headings, high-contrast body, restrained uppercase micro-labels.
layout_principles: Content density increases with screen size
Use glass panels for hierarchy and readability on dark backgrounds
design_system.animation_style: Minimal motion; use subtle hover brightness and glow. Avoid heavy parallax and gimmicky sci-fi motion.
avoid: Cheap sci-fi textures and stock imagery
Dense walls of text without hierarchy
